category_id.description: Spend for the company: the expense policy's category it was for (listClaimCategories); its account is the cost.

gst_code.description: Spend for the company: the GST code of the receipt, such as TX when it shows GST; left out, the account's default.

personal.description: true when it was personal spend: the holder owes it, recorded as an advance to them, and refunds it (recordCashAdvanceRefund).
